𝐈𝐍 𝐏𝐇𝐎𝐓𝐎𝐒 || Titay Municipal Fire Station (MFS) Shift A personnel promptly responded to a reported medical emergency at Purok Magsasaka, Barangay Poblacion, Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay, involving a 54-year-old male patient who was found unconscious and unresponsive.

Upon arrival at the scene, the responding EMS team conducted an initial assessment and ensured scene safety before approaching the patient. The patient was found lying supine on a bed, unresponsive, with a Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) score of 3 (E1V1M1). Snoring respirations were also noted, indicating possible partial upper airway obstruction. According to a relative, the patient had been experiencing generalized body weakness prior to becoming unresponsive.

Immediate intervention was initiated by repositioning the patient's airway to help maintain airway patency and address the abnormal respiratory sounds. The patient's vital signs were assessed and recorded as follows: BP 110/80 mmHg, PR 90 bpm, RR 30 cpm, SpO₂ 95%, temperature 36.1°C, and capillary refill time (CRT) greater than two seconds. His respiratory status and overall condition were closely monitored.

Due to the patient's condition, he was transported via BFP Ambulance to Dr. George T. Hofer Medical Center, Barangay Tenan, Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay, for immediate medical evaluation and definitive management.

Upon arrival at the medical facility, the patient was safely transferred and properly endorsed to the attending physician, together with the pertinent assessment findings, for continuity of care.

Titay MFS reminds the public to seek immediate medical assistance when a person experiences sudden weakness, altered consciousness, or difficulty breathing, as these may indicate a serious medical emergency.

Upon arrival at the scene, the responding team conducted a scene safety assessment and secured the area before approaching the patient. The patient was found seated along the roadside, conscious and oriented, with a patent airway and spontaneous breathing. Further assessment revealed active bleeding from the lower lip, swelling over the left zygomatic area, lacerations on both knees, and a visible deformity of the right tibia and fibula, suggestive of a possible fracture.

Immediate first aid was provided by applying direct pressure to control the bleeding and cleansing the affected areas with a mild antiseptic solution to help reduce the risk of infection. The injured right lower extremity was subsequently immobilized using a malleable splint to restrict movement, provide support, and prevent further injury. The patient's vital signs and overall condition were assessed and monitored throughout the intervention.

Following the initial assessment and first aid, the patient was transported via BFP Ambulance to Dr. George T. Hofer Medical Center, Barangay Tenan, Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay, for further medical evaluation and definitive management.

    Titay MFS Shift A personnel responded to a reported vehicular accident in Barangay Dalangin, Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay. Upon receipt of the report, the responding team immediately proceeded to the scene to provide the necessary emergency medical assistance and conduct an initial assessment of the patient(s).

     Upon arrival at the scene, the responding EMS team first ensured scene safety and secured the area before approaching the patient. One (1) male patient was found lying in a supine position along the roadside, conscious but apparently intoxicated and responsive only to painful stimuli. The patient had a patent airway and spontaneous respirations. 
      An initial physical assessment revealed visible abrasions on the parietal region of the head and the right metacarpal area. Responding EMS personnel immediately administered first aid by cleansing the affected areas with an appropriate irrigating solution, followed by the application of a mild antiseptic solution to disinfect the wounds and minimize the risk of infection. 
       The patient was promptly transported via BFP ambulance to Dr. George T. Hofer Medical Center, located in Barangay Tenan, Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay, for further medical evaluation, treatment, and appropriate medical management.Upon arrival at Dr. George T. Hofer Medical Center, the patient was safely transferred and properly endorsed to the attending physician, together with the relevant Patient Care Report (PCR) and assessment findings, for continuity of care and further medical evaluation and management.

IN PHOTOS | On November 17, 2026, the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Regional Office IX conducted its Regional Inventory of Personnel, Property, and Equipment for Calendar Year 2026 at the Titay Municipal Fire Station, Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay Province.

The activity involved the physical inspection, verification, and accounting of government-issued properties, equipment, and other accountable assets to ensure the accuracy of inventory records, promote accountability, and strengthen the proper management and utilization of government resources.

The activity was spearheaded by FSUPT JASMIN S TANOG, Regional Chief, Logistics Division; FSINSP SIENA P SENARILLOS, Chief, Accounting Division; and FSINSP LEONCIO B SAMBRANA JR., together with representatives from the Commission on Audit (COA) and participating non-officer personnel from the Regional Office IX.

The Titay Municipal Fire Station, headed by SFO4 Neil P Siaron, Acting Municipal Fire Marshal, actively participated in and facilitated the conduct of the inventory activity.

newsArticles.summary:
EARTHQUAKE INFORMATION | PHIVOLCS ADVISORY

A Magnitude 2.3 earthquake was recorded by PHIVOLCS today, 26 June 2026, at 7:09 PM, with its epicenter located 18 km North 22° West of Sarangani Island, Davao Occidental, at a depth of 81 km.

At this magnitude, no damage and aftershocks are expected.

Although this was a minor earthquake, it serves as a reminder that our municipality should always be prepared for any emergency.

🔹 Safety Reminders:
✅ Stay calm and avoid spreading unverified information.
✅ Familiarize yourself with safe evacuation areas and emergency exits.
✅ Prepare and maintain your emergency go bag.
✅ During strong earthquakes, remember: DROP, COVER, and HOLD ON.
✅ Follow only official updates from PHIVOLCS and LDRRMO-Titay.

Let us remain vigilant and always practice disaster preparedness. Being prepared today can save lives tomorrow.

Carabaña Jr., responded to a fire incident at the residence of Merryjane Husain and Rolando Husain in Mate, Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay. We continue to remind everyone to remain alert during inclement weather, as lightning strikes can pose serious risks to both lives and property.
